description: Read-only checklist: branch task_[número], commit subjects [numero] - [tipo] - [descrição], one file per commit. Compares with origin/development or origin/homolog unless base is set. next_tool is always null. Does not open a pull request.

base.description: Optional git ref to compare against (example: origin/development).

project_root.description: Absolute path of the git repository. Required for tools that read or write that repo.
